primary_contrast: local8 minus shared8, joint donor-counter and recipient-symbol success, among eligible test pairs at width16
gate: Validation only: at least29/32 free-prompt correct,29/32 prefixed continuation correct, and12/16 eligible aligned pairs. If failed stop; do not inspect or run test outcomes, alter template, expand sample size or change ranks.
scope: One fixed controlled synthetic notation-continuation case motivated by MATH validation math_2526. Not MATH accuracy, not pretraining-heldout data, not natural generated prefixes. The valid assistant prefix is supplied explicitly; independent free-prompt and prefix-conditioned capabilities are both measured.
alignment: All patch slots belong to supplied assistant prefix, last16 or last4 positions. Recipient/donor full prefix token counts and abstract token signatures must match; failures retained as exclusions without replacement.
non_target: Recipient symbol at newly generated sixth and seventh terms. The fifth symbol already belongs to the supplied prefix and is not counted as preserved output.
selection: 65 deterministic disjoint pairs, hash-select64 before outputs, first16 validation and48 test; no clean context shared between pairs. Fixed donor different symbol and start. No target fit, rank selection, layer search, alpha sweep or new random controls.
coverage: All48 test capability cases reported. Primary conditioned on both free and prefixed baselines correct and alignment valid. Also report full48 denominator with ineligible cases counted as no demonstrated success, explicitly a coverage-adjusted metric. Never hide failures.
uncertainty: Pair-level bootstrap for frozen primary; all other methods, width4, target-only and symbol-only rates secondary. Synthetic template transfer only; no claim of general reasoning control.
